summary:
Implemented the rich_measure feature by editing files only; no tests were run and nothing was committed, as requested.

Changes:
- rich/console.py: Console.print now sets justify="default" in render options; the justify passed to _collect_renderables is unchanged.
- rich/align.py: Align.__rich_console__ constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width). Added Align.__repr__. Added VerticalCenter (JupyterMixin) after Align with newline-segment vertical padding based on console.size.height, measurement delegation, and __repr__. Not registered in rich/__init__.py.
- rich/tree.py: Added iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter, four cells of indent per level) after __rich_console__, which is unchanged. Added one import: from .measure import Measurement, which the spec's no-new-imports rule would otherwise forbid, but Tree must return a Measurement.
- CHANGELOG.md: "[9.8.0] - Unreleased" heading, existing entry kept, and an Added subsection listing rich_measure for tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter.
- tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import; tests for Align repr, VerticalCenter repr, render on height-6 console (expects "\n\nfoo\n\n\n"), and measurement (3, 3).
- tests/test_tree.py: Measurement import after console; test expecting (11, 19) for the root/bar/"musroom risotto" tree.

Unverified: the test expectations were derived by reading the code, not by running pytest.
